description: Verifica del rispetto delle regole canoniche di battaglia 182 senza patch runtime.

canonical_rules.rule: battle uses 3x3 grid per team preserving grid_x/grid_y
Team A faces screen-right; Team B faces screen-left
top HUD uses splash art (HeroCard portrait), not idle/combat pose
field sprite uses combat pose / runtime sheet, not splash
battle log in drawer/chat bottom-left, toggleabile, non invasivo

canonical_rules.variance_rationale: Specifica canonica usa il termine 'circa'. Differenze rientrano nella tolleranza UX. Cambiare i valori è considerato 'formula/balance change' che il pack vieta esplicitamente. Documentato come finding informativo; nessuna patch eseguita.

canonical_rules.rule: no flicker / remount / drift / source swap instabile
safeguards: speedRef pattern per evitare drift speed mid-battle
chatDrawerNode useMemo per evitare reconcile cascade

canonical_rules.rule: post-battle: reward summary compatto + EXP + level up + MVP + Battle Report

evidence.exp_per_hero: PostBattleSummary.tsx Hero EXP list (avatar, level, exp gained, animated bar, level up)
evidence.mvp_calc: buildPostBattleSummary.ts mvp by name match + top damage_dealt fallback

canonical_rules.rule: audio cues post-battle solo TEST placeholder/policy; niente engine audio live broad
canonical_rules.observation: Nessun import audio runtime in combat.tsx, BattleReport.tsx, PostBattleSummary.tsx. Audio placeholders 12 WAV TEST presenti ma non attaccati a runtime.
NO_STAMINA_SYSTEM canonica rispettata; nessun pre-battle stamina gate; controllato pack 183.
Nessun token SYNERGY_V2_BATTLE_ACTIVE in battle_engine.py o combat.tsx.

canonical_rules.rule: no Artifact bonus / Divine Weapon runtime activation
canonical_rules.observation: Nessun token ARTIFACT_BONUS_RUNTIME o divine_weapon_active in battle_engine.py; artefatti restano locked HTTP 423.

canonical_rules.rule: no full Status Effect runtime / no full VFX runtime
canonical_rules.observation: Status effect/VFX runtime non attivati in questo pack.
